node: HVDC, FACTS, reactors, harmonic filters, instrument transformers, and grid-stability components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HVDC/FACTS/grid-stability node using a two-lane funnel. GE Vernova is included only as the obvious reference anchor because it directly sells HVDC, FACTS and STATCOM systems. The underfollowed lane prioritizes AMSC, PLPC and POWL: AMSC has the cleanest direct STATCOM/FACTS exposure; PLPC is a second-order transmission hardware supplier whose products may benefit from high-voltage line expansion; POWL is a less direct but plausible adjacent supplier of utility/industrial power distribution and control equipment. None of these entries is a trading recommendation; weak mappings are explicitly labeled as inference or hypothesis for later verification.
